final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.rating, step1.avg_price_per_day, step1.film_count, step1.avg_price_per_day / step2.overall_avg FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
